name: cad2gis-agent
description: Evidence-first CAD/DWG to GIS conversion with bounded visual and language feedback iteration.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first CAD conversion with managed QGIS review.
interface.longDescription: Inspect content-addressed CAD evidence with LibreDWG as the primary reader and AutoCAD as an explicit fallback or parallel verifier, run the canonical deterministic CAD2GIS pipeline, then use a dedicated token-authenticated QGIS desktop session for downstream review and fine-tuning.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this CAD2GIS project with LibreDWG first, use AutoCAD only after a classified primary-reader failure or for explicit parallel verification, produce a reproducible conversion run, then use the managed QGIS session only for downstream visual review and fine-tuning.
